description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the HttpUtils class, verifying its methods related to retrieving timing headers and parameters from routing contexts and HTTP server requests.

classes.name: HttpUtilsTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the functionality of HttpUtils methods related to timing headers and parameters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up mock routing context and HTTP request for testing.

methods.name: testGetTimeTillDisconnectUsesHeader
methods.description: Verifies HttpUtils.getTimeTillDisconnect retrieves value from request header.

methods.description: Verifies HttpUtils.getTimeTillDisconnect retrieves value from query parameter.

methods.name: testGetTimeTillDisconnectReturnsNullIfNotSpecified
methods.description: Ensures HttpUtils.getTimeTillDisconnect returns null if neither header nor query parameter are provided.

methods.name: testGetTimeToLiveUsesHeader
methods.description: Verifies HttpUtils.getTimeToLive retrieves value from header.
